comment: Template for an outgoing Puckai request worldlet. Replace angle-bracketed placeholders before sending. Add an `agent_guidance` block to vibecode if the request needs to specify tone, on_ambiguity behavior, or recruiting policy. Add more issue records under `records` if the request carries more than one question.
